name: R W Technologies
old_description: RW Technologies is a US-based electronic circuit board services company
about:
RW Technologies US LLC operates from Crystal Lake, Illinois, a northwest suburb of Chicago. The company was founded in 2011 by Troy Richert and Micheal Walker as a partnership to provide electronic manufacturing services.

The shop specializes in printed circuit board assembly, offering quick-turn prototypes, new product introduction (NPI) runs, and low-to-medium volume production. Its services extend to lead-free and mixed-technology assembly, surface-mount and through-hole placement, repairs and upgrades, parts procurement, component warehousing in an environmentally controlled stockroom, and box-build assembly including custom enclosures and wiring. All work is performed in the company's own facility outside Chicago.

RW Technologies serves multiple industries, with a noted example of camera modules for the telecommunications sector. Its customer base includes engineers who need fast prototypes, low unit costs, flexible design specifications, and schedule certainty for product launches.

The company differentiates itself through what it calls a Trifold Tech Approach: superior U.S. quality backed by ISO 9001:2015 and IPC-A-610 compliance, quick and flexible turnarounds enabled by lean manufacturing principles, and global cost competitiveness achieved through low overhead and manufacturing efficiencies. The founders emphasize that they are not merely order takers but partners who build each board as if it were their own.
